paragraphs: Abba Yose ben Chanan: Mishnah, Eduyot, page 69; Middot 2:6. In Rabbi Meir’s name: end of Yevamot, chapter 5, 53b. Of Jerusalem; see Yose ben Yochanan of Jerusalem above. It appears he lived in R.A.B.Y.’s time [ראב״י; provisionally Rabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov]. Abba Shaul ben Botnit speaks in his name; see his entry. In Abba Kohen Bardela’s name: Sifrei, Devarim, the section ‘Eleven days from Horeb.’ Rabbi Elazar ben Yitzchak of Kefar Darom and Rabbi Yishmael: Sotah 20b. See Midrash Rabbah, Naso, chapter 9.
